annotations.title: Section 8 contracts expiring in a state

description: Active HUD project-based Section 8 and assistance contracts (HAP, PRAC, RAC, PAC) in one state whose overall or current expiration date falls in a date window, with property name, city, county, assisted units, program, both expiration dates, rent-to-FMR ratio and FHA number. Filter by county, city, contract type and size; page through results.

county.description: Optional county name as HUD spells it, e.g. "Cuyahoga".

date_field.description: "overall" = end of the contract term (default); "current" = end of the currently funded piece, which is often renewed.

from.description: Optional window start, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the HUD file's as-of date).

limit.description: Rows to return, 1 to 20 (default 10); page with offset for more.

min_assisted_units.description: Optional minimum assisted units on the contract.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. OH.

within_months.description: Window length in months, measured from the HUD file's as-of date (default 24, as on the deal screen). Ignored when "through" is given.
